subject: OpenRepo webhook + self-hosted runner — demo & integration questions
messages:
From: Kate Miller <kate@openrepo.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 18:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick questions before demo (webhooks / self-hosted runner)

Hi Naomi,

I signed up through the self-serve flow and selected an interest in the GitHub connector. A couple of technical questions before we schedule a demo:

- Does Redwood's webhook handling support a shared secret + HMAC signature verification for events? We need that for our security review.
- We run a self-hosted runner fleet behind our internal network (Docker-based). Can Redwood's integration trigger actions to that fleet, or do we need to route via GitHub Actions?

If you can point me to any docs or sample configs, that would help our engineering team evaluate quickly. Would appreciate a 30-min demo next week — mornings US/PST work best.

Thanks,
Kate
Lead Platform Engineer
OpenRepo Inc.

[attachment: integration-sample-logs.txt]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Miller <kate@openrepo.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick questions before demo (webhooks / self-hosted runner)

Hi Kate — welcome and great questions.

Short answers up front:
- Yes, we support HMAC signatures on incoming webhooks and you can configure the verification secret on a per-integration basis.
- For self-hosted runner fleets, there are two common patterns we see: either trigger via GitHub Actions (recommended for simplicity) or use our webhook router plus a small runner adapter (Docker image) that you can host internally for direct action invocation. Both are supported; I can share a sample adapter repo.

I looped in Marissa (demo AE) and Ben (solutions engineer) so we can cover the connector demo and a quick architecture sketch. Attached is a short 1-page demo agenda and a link to our quick-start repo.

Can you do either of these 30-min slots (PST)?
- Tue 11/10 09:00–09:30
- Wed 11/11 10:30–11:00

If those don't work, send a few times that fit your mornings and we'll accommodate.

Thanks,
Naomi
SDR — Redwood Inference
